body.label: New number, old play (bank)
body.text: LAKEVIEW FRAUD DEPT: we stopped a $980 charge attempt. To reverse it and secure your money, move it to a protected account today. Call (972) 555-0161.

body.label: Toll scam, new domain
body.text: TX toll services: your unpaid toll balance gets a late fee at midnight. Settle it now: https://txtoll-pay.top

body.label: Grandparent scam, no number
body.text: Nana it's me, I'm in a bad spot and can't call anyone else. Can you send money through Western Union tonight? I'll pay you back.

body.label: Real bank alert (look-alike)
body.text: Lakeview Credit Union: A $1,249.00 purchase at BestMart was approved. If this wasn't you, call the number on the back of your card.

body.label: Friend with a new number
body.text: Hi! It's Sam, I got a new number. Save this one. Are we still on for lunch Saturday?
